description: Fetch full details of a federal award by its generated unique award ID. Returns contract or assistance award data including recipient identity (UEI, parent organization, business categories), agency hierarchy, period of performance, place of performance, Assistance Listings with the obligation under each, loan face value and subsidy cost for loans, funding account linkages (account_obligations_by_defc), parent IDV information, and subaward count. Use generated_internal_id values from usaspending_search_awards as input. Recipient and parent recipient hashes can be passed to usaspending_get_recipient; NAICS codes can be used in usaspending_search_awards filters, and Assistance Listing numbers in its assistance_listings filter. For IDV-category awards (category="idv"), use usaspending_get_idv_awards to list the child contracts and task/delivery orders placed under them.

award_id.description: Generated unique award ID (e.g., CONT_AWD_FA862118F6251_9700_FA862115D6276_9700) — use generated_internal_id from usaspending_search_awards

name: usaspending_get_award

account_obligations_by_defc.description: Funding breakdown by Disaster/Emergency Funding (DEF) code — links to disaster appropriations

items.description: DEF code entry with code and obligation amount

amount.description: Obligation amount in USD for this DEF code

code.description: DEF code identifying the emergency supplemental

assistance_listings.description: Every Assistance Listing (CFDA program) funding the award, in upstream order; absent for contracts and IDVs

items.description: One Assistance Listing funding the award

number.description: Assistance Listing (CFDA) number, e.g. 93.855 — usable in usaspending_search_awards assistance_listings

obligation.description: Federal obligation in USD made under this listing

base_and_all_options_value.description: Base and all options value in USD (contracts)

category.description: Award category: contract, idv, grant, loans, direct payment, insurance, or other

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `award_not_found`: No award exists for the given award ID. `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

generated_unique_award_id.description: Parent award chaining ID — pass to usaspending_get_award for parent IDV details

place_of_performance.description: Place of performance; absent when upstream reports no location fields

country_code.description: Three-letter country code of performance (e.g. USA)

business_categories.description: Recipient business category names (e.g. "Higher Education", "U.S. Local Government") — not the codes usaspending_get_recipient returns as business_types

location.description: Recipient address; absent when upstream reports no location fields

parent_recipient_id.description: Parent recipient hash ID (ends in -P) — pass to usaspending_get_recipient for the parent organization profile

recipient_id.description: Recipient hash ID — pass to usaspending_get_recipient for full profile

subaward_count.description: Number of subawards; use with usaspending_get_award_subawards

total_loan_value.description: Face value of the loan in USD (category "loans" only). A loan reports its value here, not in total_obligation, which is often 0.

total_subsidy_cost.description: Estimated cost to the government of the loan subsidy in USD (category "loans" only)

title: Get Award Details
